banner: SIMULATED: not Dr. Polys's sc: ontology; grade S; see sim/ and harness/gen_sim.py

reported_real.source: README (27) finding 4 / DOC section 1 via fork PR #5 body, grade L

concepts.label: affordance
concepts.comment: What a viewer or agent can do with a node: click, enter, follow.

concepts.label: collidable
concepts.comment: Geometry the avatar cannot pass; proxy simplifies the test.

concepts.label: metadata tag
concepts.comment: Out-of-band facts attached to a node for agents and ledgers.

concepts.label: pickable
concepts.comment: Target of a picking sensor.

concepts.label: proximity zone
concepts.comment: A box that fires when the viewer enters.

concepts.label: route wiring
concepts.comment: Event path between typed fields; type mismatches are semantic errors.

concepts.label: triggerable
concepts.comment: A sensor event that starts an animation: isOver, touchTime.

concepts.label: castle
concepts.comment: Walls, towers, gate, keep.
concepts.basis: Polys 2024: castle; step 4: gemini 3 of 40 with a floating part

concepts.label: duck
concepts.comment: Head, body, beak, wings, tail as attached volumes.

concepts.label: ball geon
concepts.comment: A spherical volume.

concepts.label: block geon
concepts.comment: A box-like volume as a basic recognisable part.

concepts.label: column geon
concepts.comment: A cylinder.

concepts.label: pointer geon
concepts.comment: A cone: has a direction models rarely set.

concepts.label: sweep geon
concepts.comment: A cross-section swept along a spine.

concepts.label: human figure
concepts.comment: Head, torso, arms, legs, attached.
concepts.basis: Polys 2024: human figure; step 4: gpt-4o 27 of 40

concepts.label: water pump
concepts.comment: Base, barrel, handle, spout; handle pivots.

concepts.label: recognition by components
concepts.comment: An object is recognised as a few volumes in relation.

concepts.label: sailboat
concepts.comment: Hull, mast, sail, keel.
concepts.basis: Polys 2024: sailboat; step 4: gpt-4o 17 of 38 with a floating part

concepts.label: cloth frame
concepts.comment: Shared coordinate frame for the cloth: positions are in cm from the strip edge.
concepts.basis: REPORT.md: 4.37 x 1.11 m surface, plate frame

concepts.label: evidence row
concepts.comment: A graded claim: value, uncertainty, primary source, second witness.

concepts.label: burn hole
concepts.comment: A hole traced from the 2002 photograph with a position and size.
concepts.basis: REPORT.md: eight big holes 68 +/- 3 cm from ends and middle

concepts.label: grade Confirmed
concepts.comment: Peer-reviewed measurement with stated uncertainty, independently reproduced or unrefuted.

concepts.label: grade Contested
concepts.comment: Peer-reviewed results on both sides.

concepts.label: grade Likely
concepts.comment: Peer-reviewed, one group.

concepts.label: grade Question
concepts.comment: The record is silent.

concepts.label: grade Suspected
concepts.comment: Conference, book, preprint, or contradicted without rebuttal.

concepts.label: position status
concepts.comment: measured, estimated, geometric or question: how a feature's position is known.
concepts.basis: REPORT.md: 195 DEF-named features each carry position_status

concepts.label: synthetic figure
concepts.comment: Not a replica: must be declared in the scene head.
concepts.basis: shroud-print: SYNTHETIC FIGURE - NOT A REPLICA

concepts.label: attached to
concepts.comment: Part joined to another; arms to torsos, wings to bodies. No schema states this.
concepts.basis: step 4: parts touching nothing, human figure 27 of 40 gpt-4o scenes

concepts.label: cone direction
concepts.comment: Which way a cone points; the default is +Y, and models rarely set a direction.

concepts.label: contact
concepts.comment: Two parts' world-space bounds touch within a tolerance.

concepts.label: floating part
concepts.comment: A part that touches nothing in its composite: a lower-bound defect signal.

concepts.label: gap
concepts.comment: Measured separation between two parts that should touch.

concepts.label: part
concepts.comment: A visible volume that is one element of a composite object.
concepts.basis: parts_contact.py: Box, Sphere, Cone, Cylinder, point lists

concepts.label: penetration
concepts.comment: One part sinks into another beyond tolerance.
concepts.basis: step 4: 24 of 40 sink or leave a gap

concepts.label: pivot at hinge
concepts.comment: Animation pivot placed where the part actually hinges, not at the origin.
concepts.basis: Polys 2024: pump handle rolled instead of swung

concepts.label: rests on
concepts.comment: A part rests on another: vertical contact with support from below.
concepts.basis: step 4: 'on top of' strict = resting contact; 15 of 34 gpt-4o valid scenes

concepts.label: support chain
concepts.comment: Every part rests on something that rests on the ground: a stability reading.

concepts.label: supports
concepts.comment: Inverse of RestsOn.

concepts.label: whole
concepts.comment: A grouping that is more than the sum of its parts: a named composite.

concepts.label: eye height
concepts.comment: Height of the viewer above the walking surface; should be plausible against the avatar and the scene scale.
concepts.check: semantic rule (proposed): avatarSize[1] vs scene bbox
concepts.basis: DOC Q1 eye height against avatarSize

concepts.label: camera facing content
concepts.comment: The default view shows the content: not blank (<0.05% non-background pixels) and not sparse (<1%).
concepts.basis: fork PR #5 frame-check thresholds as quoted in DOC

concepts.label: field of view
concepts.comment: Angular extent; X3D spans the smaller viewport dimension, so aspect ratio changes the horizontal view.

concepts.label: headlight
concepts.comment: Whether a camera-attached light guarantees visibility in unlit scenes.

concepts.label: navigation mode
concepts.comment: How a person or agent moves: WALK, FLY, EXAMINE, LOOKAT, ANY.

concepts.label: orbit pivot
concepts.comment: The point examine-mode navigation rotates about; should sit on or near the subject.

concepts.label: view direction
concepts.comment: Where the camera points; orientation rotates the default -Z look vector.

concepts.label: view position
concepts.comment: Camera location in world space; must lie outside solid geometry for a useful first frame.

concepts.label: viewpoint description
concepts.comment: Human-readable name so an agent can list and choose views.

concepts.label: visibility horizon
concepts.comment: Far distance beyond which geometry is culled; interacts with scale regimes.

concepts.label: navigation speed
concepts.comment: Metres per second; a giga-scale scene needs a different speed than a nano-scale one.

concepts.label: above
concepts.comment: Separation along camera up with a gap.
concepts.basis: step 4: prompt 3, 22 strictly separated of 33 valid

concepts.label: aligned
concepts.comment: Shared edge or centre line within tolerance.

concepts.label: below
concepts.comment: Mirror of Above.

concepts.label: beside
concepts.comment: Adjacent along an axis with a bounded gap.

concepts.label: between
concepts.comment: Lies between two parts on a line.

concepts.label: in front of
concepts.comment: Nearer the camera along the view axis.

concepts.label: inside
concepts.comment: Contained within another volume's bounds.

concepts.label: larger than
concepts.comment: Compares bounding extents.

concepts.label: left of
concepts.comment: Relation judged on the camera's axes, not the world's.
concepts.basis: step 4: prompt 4, every valid scene correct

concepts.label: on top of
concepts.comment: Above plus resting contact.

concepts.label: right of
concepts.comment: Mirror of LeftOf on the camera's x axis.

concepts.label: bounding volume
concepts.comment: bboxCenter and bboxSize let a runtime cull at any scale.

concepts.label: geospatial precision
concepts.comment: Coordinates held in doubles with an explicit geoSystem.

concepts.label: giga scale
concepts.comment: Whole-structure scale (a shell around a star): relative precision dominates.

concepts.label: human scale
concepts.comment: Metres; the default unit and the one navigation speed assumes.

concepts.label: instanced repetition
concepts.comment: DEF once, USE many: a million-panel shell stays small.

concepts.label: level of detail
concepts.comment: Swap representations by distance so giga and nano coexist.

concepts.label: nano scale
concepts.comment: Features in micrometres to nanometres; float32 loses them far from the origin.
concepts.basis: IEEE float32 has a 24-bit significand; this is arithmetic, not a measured result

concepts.label: planetary scale
concepts.comment: Kilometres to megametres; needs double precision or geospatial nodes.

concepts.label: scene budget
concepts.comment: Node and byte counts a runtime can render at a target frame rate.

concepts.label: unit declaration
concepts.comment: UNIT statement declares category, name, conversion factor so scale is explicit.

concepts.label: rung 0: parses
concepts.comment: Well-formed XML or JSON.

concepts.label: rung 1: typed
concepts.comment: Field types and enumerations.

concepts.label: rung 2: valid
concepts.comment: XSD for the declared version.

concepts.label: rung 3: coherent
concepts.comment: DEF/USE, ROUTE types, profile and components.

concepts.label: rung 4: lawful
concepts.comment: Domain rules: what may contain what, units, support.

concepts.label: rung 5: visible
concepts.comment: Something draws, framed sensibly.

concepts.label: rung 6: complete
concepts.comment: Shows what was asked.

concepts.label: rung 7: meaningful
concepts.comment: True to source, owner and purpose.

fixture.note: real test fixture; one grounding is deliberately unresolvable
